A lookup for subject schemes, not a catalogue of titles. **BISAC 2025 → Thema 1.6** is the public EDItEUR / BISG mapping (source of truth). **DDC, LCSH and GND** are heuristics for internal use — useful to steer a classifier, not a WebDewey licence.

The interactive table uses the tools chrome. Open it here:

[Open the BISAC → Thema lookup](tools/bisac-thema.html)

Further searching, if the row is not enough:

- [Thema browser (English)](https://ns.editeur.org/thema/en) · [Thema-Browser (Deutsch)](https://ns.editeur.org/thema/de)
- [Thema at EDItEUR](https://www.editeur.org/151/Thema)
- [LCSH at id.loc.gov](https://id.loc.gov/authorities/subjects.html)
- [OGND — SWB / K10plus Online-GND](https://swb.bsz-bw.de/DB=2.104/)
- [lobid-gnd](https://lobid.org/gnd)
